NONE: › US informal If a vehicle, etc. can turn, stop, etc. on a dime, it can turn, etc. in a very small space.
（車輛等）能在極小的空間內（轉彎）

example: The high-tech steering means that even huge tractors can turn on a dime.
高科技轉向裝置使巨大的拖拉機也可以在極小的空間內轉彎。

NONE: › If you tell people something on a need-to-know basis, you only tell them the facts they need to know at the time they need to know them, and nothing more.
僅限於人們需要知道的東西

處於險境；境況岌岌可危

由於被指控有欺詐行爲，這名政客的職業生涯岌岌可危。

NONE: › If you do something on a shoestring, you do it with a very small amount of money.
以極少量資金

example: The film was made on a shoestring.
這部電影是個小製作。

NONE: › If you do something on a wing and a prayer, you do it hoping that you will succeed, although you are not prepared enough for it.
準備不充分但又希望成功

example: With hardly any funding and a staff of six, they were operating on a wing and a prayer.
幾乎沒有什麼資金而且只有6名員工，他們的經營如履薄冰。

NONE: › with your hands and knees on the ground
趴在地上，匍匐著

example: You'll have to get down on all fours to clean behind the toilet.
你要趴到地上才能擦洗到馬桶後面的區域。

NONE: › without eating anything
空著肚子，空腹

example: You should never go to work on an empty stomach.
你不應該空腹去上班。

NONE: › regular and well-balanced and not likely to change suddenly
平穩下來；順順當當

example: The new manager succeeded in putting the business back on an even keel.
新任經理成功地使公司業務恢復正常。

NONE: C1 If something happens on and off during a period of time, it happens sometimes.
時斷時續地；間歇地

example: I've had toothache on and off for a couple of months.
我的牙斷斷續續疼了幾個月。

NONE: › doing something without thinking about it or without making an effort
無意識地；不假思索地；機械地，習慣性地

example: I worked the last hour of my shift on autopilot.
下班前的一個小時，我完全就是靠慣性熬過來的。

NONE: › as part of a group or team, especially for a special purpose
（尤指為了特殊目的而）參與
› used to refer to things that are carried by a vehicle and form part of it
（車輛上）安裝的，裝載的

example: Let's bring Rob on board for the Saudi deal - he's the expert.
讓羅布也參與跟沙烏地阿拉伯做的這筆交易吧——他是這方面的專家。

這輛車上裝了衛星導航系統。

NONE: › If a worker such as a doctor is on call, he or she is available to work or make official visits at any time when needed.
（醫療從業者的）聽候召喚，待命
› used to describe workers who are available to make official visits at any time when they are needed
（工作人員）隨叫隨到的，待命的
› relating to the work of someone who is available at any time when needed
（工作）需要所叫隨到的，隨時待命的

example: She's a doctor, so she's often on call at the weekend.
她是個醫生，所以在週末常常要隨時準備出診。

an on-call specialist/firefighter/judge

我的新工作每週工作20小時，沒有待命任務。

NONE: › at any time that someone wants or needs something

應顧客要求即可提供的，隨選的

可點播的

視頻點播服務

他們認為人工流產應該是本人要求就施行的手術。

他們會將一個語音辨識系統作為附加的隨選服務提供給使用者。

在圖書館倉庫裡，機器人會管理存貯並取出顧客隨選的書。

這個地區的大部分人連電視機都沒有，更別說點播電影了。
Cable customers pay an extra $6.95 a month for on-demand.
有線電視使用者每月多交6.95美元可獲得視頻點播服務。

NONE: › Money that is on deposit is saved in a bank or something similar.
（錢）儲蓄的

example: I've got £5,000 on deposit in the bank.
我在這家銀行裡有5000英鎊存款。

NONE: › rich
生活優裕，富有
› being talked about by a lot of people
廣為談論的，議論紛紛的

example: The question now on everyone's lips is "Will he resign?"
目前大家議論紛紛的話題是：他會辭職嗎？

NONE: C2 near to someone or something, and ready to help or be used if necessary
在跟前，在旁邊

example: A 1,200-strong military force will be on hand to monitor the ceasefire.
將有一支1200人的部隊在現場監督停火。
For those of you who don't have an atlas to hand, Newcastle is a city in the northeast of England.
謹向手上沒有地圖冊的人說明，新堡是英格蘭東北部的一座城市。

NONE: › literary in heaven
在天上
› mainly humorous If an order comes from on high, it comes from someone in a position of authority.
（命令）由上級下達的，來自高層的

example: God looked down from on high.
上帝在天上看著我們。

上級指示要縮減我們的差旅費用。

NONE: › Something that is on its last legs is in such bad condition that it will soon be unable to work as it should.
快用壞了，快用到頭了

example: I've had this laptop for five years now, and it's really on its last legs.
這台筆記型電腦我已經用了5年了，現在的確是快要報廢了。

NONE: › (of a politician) saying things in public that support the official ideas of his or her political party
（政界人士在公開場合講話與所在政黨的官方觀點）一致地，口徑一致地

example: The candidate is clearly on message with the party leadership.
這位候選人顯然跟黨領袖觀點一致。

NONE: C2 If something must on no account/not on any account be done, it must not be done at any time or for any reason.
決不，絕對不；切莫

example: Employees must on no account make personal phone calls from the office.
員工無論如何不能因為私事使用辦公室電話。

這些紀錄無論如何都不能變動。

NONE: › something that you say when you are speaking about two opposite ways of thinking about or reacting to a situation
一方面…另一方面

example: On one level I quite like the attention but on another level, I suppose I find it a little disturbing.
一方面我很喜歡這種關注，但另一方面我又覺得這種關注對我有些干擾。

NONE: › judging something by how it has been planned rather than how it really works in practice
據書面材料，在書面上，在理論上

example: The design certainly looks good on paper.
該設計從理論上看起來的確很不錯。

有幾個應徵者從申請表上看條件不錯，但面試都沒有通過。

NONE: › US worried or excited about something that is going to happen
為即將發生的事情而擔心（或激動），如坐針氈

example: Don’t keep Margaret on pins and needles – give her a call.
別讓瑪格麗特擔心了，給她打個電話。

NONE: › If something is said to be on someone's or something's account, it is because of that person or thing.
為了…的緣故

example: I'm not very hungry, so please don't cook on my account (= don't cook just for me).
我不是太餓，所以請不要特意為我做飯。

他們很累，但是他們的熱情並沒有因此而減退。

NONE: › very close to where someone is or lives
靠近；在…家附近

example: There's a lovely park right on our doorstep.
離我們住處不遠有個很漂亮的公園。

NONE: › poor, without a job or a place to live, and often drinking too much alcohol
（失業酒徒）無家可歸的
› Something in industry or business that is on stream is being produced or is available for use
在生產中；投入使用

example: The company's increased sales were primarily a result of new stores coming on stream.
公司銷售額增長主要是新店開始營業的結果。

NONE: › If you are on target with a piece of work, you are making good progress and likely to achieve what you planned.
進展順利的，成功在望的

大家都只好把計劃暫時擱置一段時間。

NONE: › in a hurried way, without much detail

計算出來的價格不很精確——看起來似乎他只是粗略算了一下。

NONE: › by using or taking advantage of someone or something else
利用，叨…的光

他們一直在叨知名企業的光做生意。

NONE: › soon after an earlier success, and as a result of it
由於（不久前的某項成就）

example: The advertising agency secured the contract on the back of its previous successful campaigns.
由於先期的宣傳工作富有成效，這家廣告公司最終獲得了該合約。

NONE: › When a machine is on the blink, it is not working correctly.
（機器）失靈，出毛病
› drinking a lot of alcohol
喝大量的酒，狂飲

example: Every Friday night Rick would go out on the booze.
每週五晚上力克都出去大喝一頓。

NONE: › one after another with nothing else between

這支隊伍已獲得了五連勝。

NONE: C2 exactly at the stated or expected time
準時

example: The plane landed at two o'clock on the dot.
飛機兩點鐘準時降落。

11點正她準時趕了過來。

NONE: C2 used when you are describing how a situation seems on the surface
從表面看；乍看起來

從表面上看這好像是便宜，但我肯定其中有些隱藏的費用。

NONE: › involving ordinary workers rather than managers
涉及普通工人（而非管理者）

example: That sort of decision should be taken on the factory floor.
那種決定應由廠房工人作。

NONE: › informal If you do something on the fly, you do it quickly, often while you are doing something else, without preparing and without thinking too much about how it should be done.
為經準備或較多考慮就開始匆忙做…（往往與其他事情一起進行）

無需中斷一個已經運行的電腦程式（而同時執行其他功能）

這一新規則似乎未經考慮就匆匆制定了。

他寫了一個程式，可即時翻譯日語。

NONE: › US getting or needing immediate attention
得到（或需要）立刻的關注

example: A few important members of Congress are making an effort to keep human rights on the front burner.
幾名重要的國會議員正在努力將人權問題保留在重要的議事日程上。

NONE: › very busy
忙個不停的，特別忙的
› UK in the process of being produced
正在生產中，處於生產過程中

example: I've been on the go all day, and I'm really tired.
我一整天都忙個不停，真的很累。

你知道她正在寫一本新書嗎？

NONE: › among the general public
在公眾中，在普通百姓中

example: Their political ideas have a lot of support on the ground.
他們的政治觀點得到公眾廣泛支持。

NONE: › If you do something on the hoof, you do it while you are moving about or doing something else, often without giving it the attention it deserves.
順便地，草草地

example: I've got a meeting downtown in 20 minutes so I'll have lunch on the hoof.
20分鐘後我在市中心還有個會議，所以只好在路上順便吃午飯了。

NONE: C1 likely to happen or exist soon
即將發生

example: There is no new drug on the horizon that will make this disease easier to treat.
目前還沒有甚麼新藥能使治療這種疾病變得更容易。

NONE: › If you have something on the house, it is given to you free by a business.
由商家免費提供的

example: All the drinks were on the house.
所有飲料都是免費的。

NONE: › If someone is on the inside, they have a job or position in which they have special or secret information.
在（機構或組織的）內部；參與內部機密

example: Who do we know on the inside who can help us?
我們認識哪位能幫助我們的內部人士？

NONE: › too large, small, etc. for a particular purpose
太大／太小（等等）

example: This dress is on the large side for me.
對我來說，這件裙子太大了。

NONE: › If a dangerous person or animal is on the loose, that person or animal is free to move around a place and harm people.
（危險分子）在逃，未受管制

example: Brewer escaped from prison last year and has been on the loose ever since.
布魯爾自去年越獄後一直在逃。

NONE: › If a suggestion is approved on the nod, it is accepted without discussion.
（建議未經討論）一致通過

example: The new proposal went through on the nod.
新提案得到一致通過。

NONE: › exactly right, often an exact amount of money or time
（常指錢或時間）準確無誤

example: Her description of the play was right on the nose.
她對這部戲的描述真是分毫不差。

NONE: B2 used when you are comparing two different facts or two opposite ways of thinking about a situation
一方面…，另一方面…

一方面我想要一份薪水更高的工作，但另一方面我也喜歡現在的工作。

NONE: C2 done or experienced by someone
由某人所作；由某人所經歷

example: This was a misjudgment on the part of the government.
這是政府方面的誤判。
A little humility on her part would be appreciated.
希望她能表現出一點人性。

NONE: › secretly
秘密地，不為人注意地，暗地裡

example: His wife found out he'd been seeing someone on the quiet.
他妻子發現他一直在偷偷地和別人約會。

NONE: › unhappy and confused because a close, romantic relationship of yours has recently finished
（因失戀而）處於心灰意懶的狀態

尼克離開她五個月後，她心灰意冷地嫁給了另外一個男人。

NONE: › If you say something on the record, you state it publicly.
公開發表；公開表明

example: None of the company directors were prepared to comment on the record yesterday.
昨天，公司董事沒有哪個願意公開發表意見。

NONE: › looking younger/older than a particular age
看起來比某一年齡小／大
› obeying/not obeying the law
遵守／違反法律

example: After coming out of prison, he tried to stay on the right side of the law.
出獄後，他努力遵規守法。

NONE: › informal likely to fail soon
瀕臨崩潰
› If you have an alcoholic drink on the rocks, you have it with pieces of ice.
（酒）加冰塊的

example: I think their marriage is on the rocks.
我覺得他們的婚姻瀕臨解體。
I'll have a whisky on the rocks, please.
請給我來杯加冰塊的威士卡。

NONE: › doing badly and likely to fail
處於困境；即將失敗，即將完蛋

example: I think the business is finally on the ropes.
我覺得這家企業最終要垮掉了。

NONE: › while hurrying to go somewhere
在趕路的途中

example: I eat breakfast on the run if I'm late for work.
如果我上班要晚了，就在路上吃早飯。

NONE: › close to discovering
快要找到，已獲得線索

example: "We're on the scent of something big," said the police chief.
「我們快要抓到大魚了，」警長說。

NONE: › not noticed or not used
被忽視的；被擱置的；廢棄的

（通常指女子）年齡太大而找不到結婚對象的

重要的是，要把研究運用於實際當中，而不是束之高閣。

在那個時代，如果你到30歲還未結婚，那就肯定嫁不出去了。

NONE: C2 in addition to your main job
兼職
› secretly
秘密地

（餐館中的食物）裝在另一個盤子裡；作爲配菜

他靠業餘時間兼職清洗窗戶賺些零用錢。
I think he has another woman on the side (= a relationship with a woman who is not his wife).
我認爲他還有別的女人。
I'd like a salad with the dressing on the side (= with the dressing served separately from the salad), please.
我要一盤沙拉，調味醬單獨盛盤，謝謝。
I'll have a omelette with fries on the side, please.
我要一個煎蛋餅，另要一盤炸薯條，謝謝。

NONE: › (of the price of food or drink that a regular customer buys) recorded so that they can pay for it at another time
記賬，賒賬

example: Could you put these drinks on the slate?
你能將這些飲料記賬嗎？

NONE: C2 used to say that a decision, action, etc. is sudden and done without any planning
（決定、行動等）一時衝動的，心血來潮的

我們本來沒打算走的——這是一時衝動作出的決定。

我們一時心血來潮，立刻跳上汽車向海邊開去。

NONE: › without a home
無家可歸的，流落街頭的

example: Some of these people have been living on the streets for years.
這些人中有一些已經流落街頭好幾年了。

NONE: › If you do something on the strength of something such as advice, you do it because you have been influenced by it or believe it.
受…的影響；基於對…的信任

在我兄弟的建議下，我投資了這家公司。

NONE: › If a plan or suggestion has been put/laid on the table, it has been made available for people to hear, read, or discuss.

在…的開始，在…的起點

NONE: › enjoying yourself by going to places of entertainment in a town or city
去城裡的娛樂場所玩樂

example: I was out on the town/I had a night on the town last night, and I'm exhausted!
我昨晚去城裡玩了一個晚上，現在累壞了！

NONE: › If you do things on the trot, you do them directly after each other without pausing.

他們獲得了三連勝。

NONE: › mainly US informal Someone who is on the up (and up) is honest and can be trusted.
誠實的；值得信賴的

蒸蒸日上；不斷進步

瀕於崩潰／接近成功／差點流淚／瀕臨死亡／瀕臨災難／處於戰爭的邊緣

NONE: B1 generally
總的來說；整體上講

我們有過糟糕的時期，但整體上來說還是相當快樂的。

除（尤指令人不快之事）之外（還）

NONE: C2 extremely happy
極度幸福

example: She was feeling on top of the world.
